CustomField.inlineHelpText: Soft-archives this OFFERING as a whole, hiding it from the GTM Offerings Dashboard listing. Only meaningful on the offering's own tile section (Section_Key__c='tile', Template_Type__c='offerings-listing') -- it is not a per-section field, and it never deletes the record or its content. Independent of Offering_Status__c: either one hides the offering. This is NOT the same as Status__c (that section's own edit is unpublished) or Active__c (hides one section only).
CustomField.label: Archived
